A calcified, rock-hard eyeball preserved deep in the earth. Beneath the dense mineral crust, a faint spark still lingers.

§6Discovery§r
• §7Mining:§r Found encased within deposits of §5Mysterious Stone§r between §bY = -64 and Y = 0§r.
• §7Trading:§r Seasoned tavern §6Barkeepers§r occasionally stock petrified eyes for 20 Emeralds.

§6Awakening on the Grindstone§r

Right-click a §bGrindstone§r with a Petrified Eye to carefully carve away the fossilized stone. Success yields an §5Awakened Eye§r, though excessive friction can shatter the brittle shell into dust.
